title: dendrolycopodium obscurum
intro: Dendrolycopodium obscurum, commonly known as Eastern Ground Pine, is a species of club moss in the family Lycopodiaceae. It is a perennial plant that is native to North America and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is said to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Dendrolycopodium obscurum include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antispasmodic, anti-allergic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
